mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 20 trading days indicates an easing monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 20 days, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a 5-day window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 5 days, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (measured over the prior 60 days) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 60 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (above 2.0% annualized), supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate profit margins expand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth rate in real GDP (as measured by the quarterly GDPC1 series) indicates a strengthening economy, which typically supports higher corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 60-day window signals a potential need for aggressive monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 60 days, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 5 days indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises over the prior 5 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high federal funds rate (above 4.0% per annum), monetary policy is restrictive, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
